correctness.rationale: Greedy arch count equals the subsequence universality index by a constructive missing-word witness. For adjacent-distinct labeled words the exact next-letter transition counts depend only on the number of already seen letters; the finite-state series elimination yields the stated all-q rational identity, checked independently by brute force and exact rational polynomial multiplication. Minimal-length permutation blocks give the exact count, and explicit arch extension gives the exact support. Under uniform proper-word sampling, successive arch lengths are i.i.d. sums of geometrical waiting times by strong Markov and label symmetry; exact means/variances and classical renewal LLN/CLT justify the fluctuation claims. Finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The simplest complete symmetric no-self-loop regular language is natural in string constraints and coding. A uniform closed all-alphabet length-index distribution is a complete natural structural invariant, with precise shortest-word counts, a sharp two-letter versus higher-alphabet support change, and an exact stationary universality growth law. It has explicit use for enumeration and sampling of constrained universal strings and is not merely a tabulated computation or generic restatement of a DFA algorithm.
